Let the field finish its work unwatched. | The fallen go back to the soil, and the soil does not ask whose side they fought on.}
407: {Teeth of the winter, claws of the flood, come down on what stands against me. | Wind out of the north, stripper of orchards, come this way. Here stands an orchard for thee. | By root, by rind, by leaf, by seed, and by the fifth thing that has no name in any mortal tongue.} {Nothing breaks in the first minute, and much breaks in the tenth. | The tide is called up out of the deep and it does not ask where the shore is. | Water finds the way in and takes as long as it needs. That is the method and the threat.} {The target only stands on the wrong side of a season that has been hurried. | Growth is the only force here, and growth is patient, and that is why it wins. | The ground gives freely and remembers everything it gave.}
408: {O spirit that rulest the stone, hear the voice of the operator, who calls thee by thine office. | The first calling is spoken once. There will be three, and the third is iron. | By the seal I have cut, and by the blood still wet upon it: come.} {Weight is the argument. Nothing under this art moves quickly, and nothing under it is refused. | The bones of the world are woken, and the world rises to its feet. | Stone holds its answer for an age and gives it all at once.} {The seal binds both ways, and the lighter of the two bound is the spirit. | The compulsion holds as long as the breath that carried it, and not one moment longer. | It answers to the office and never to the man. Whoever stands in the ring is master.}
409:
{Sun at rising, sun at noon, sun at setting: three gates, and Gentle Breeze passes through the one that stands open. | Field, hear Gentle Breeze. Gentle Breeze, take the field. The two of you are bound now, and the binding holds. | Oak and ash and thorn, the three that never bowed: stand with me now.} {The sky draws one breath and lets it out as a gale. | The air is already moving. The art is to seize its direction. | Wind is pressure given a will, and pressure is what breaks gates.} {Take root. Take root. Take root a third time, and hold. | Thorn, hold. Root, grip. Water, rise. Wind, turn and strike from the other side. | Marrow, mend. Sinew, draw tight. Life, return to the house thou hast left.}

{What is asked of a living thing is granted, and the granting costs that thing its blood. | The year is a long sentence. The charm speaks it in one breath, and the meaning stands. | It runs strong on ground that has been walked, stronger on ground that has been worked, and dies on bare stone.} {Leave an offering. What it is matters little. That it was left matters greatly. | Kneel where you stood. Let the field finish its work unwatched. | Return the leaf to where the leaf was taken, wet side to the earth.}
41: {The Bubishi names thirty-six vital points, and the knee is not among the forgiving ones | A wounded wolf is still a wolf; a lamed one is only meat}. {Take the leg and the rest follows | Strike where they stand, and they will not stand long | The swiftest foe is the first I slow}. {Now you are mine to reach, and I am not yours | Run, if you can}.
410:
{"From fear of Him the fire burns, from fear of Him the sun shines" (the Upanishads) | "On this shewed our Lord that the Passion of Him is the overcoming of the Fiend" (Julian of Norwich, Revelations of Divine Love) | "Thou art the God One, who camest into being in the beginning of time" (the Egyptian Book of the Dead)}. {Om. The syllable that is all of this. Om, and the world bends toward the one who calls | Namo tassa bhagavato arahato. Homage to the Awakened, and after the homage a silence that does not break | Kyrie eleison, once for the body, once for the will, once for what the will is about to do}. {The light is asked for, and it descends in the shape of the asking | The radiance falls, and darkness has nowhere left to stand | The covenant is older than the caster and it is not broken on the field}. {Strike the bell at the beginning and let another hand strike it at the end | Turn the stole, set the candle between thyself and three enemies at random, and begin the psalm at the seventh verse | Turn the mala toward the body, never away, and let each bead fall like a sentence}.

{Ask for the blow. The asking is what makes it judgement | Speak the Name once, and do not soften it | Empty the vessel of every trace of wisdom first, for a full vessel receives nothing}. {Emptiness is room made ready, and light sparkle is what fills it | The vow binds the caster, and the bound caster binds the world | The prayer is heard before it is said. The saying only opens the door}.

{Amen. So it is, and so it shall be | Sarva mangalam. May all be auspicious, and all that was done stand | Bow once to the altar and once to the door, and leave without turning}.
411:
{The source is the caster at three hundred and ten kelvin. The sink is everything else. | One joule per gram, delivered in eleven milliseconds. The interval is the weapon. | p V = n R T. Five letters, and the one who holds the pen decides which of them yields.} {The charge is gathered, held one breath too long, and loosed along the path cleared for it. | Lightning takes the readiest way down, and the art is the readying. | The flash is the least of it. What travels is the current, through all that conducts.} {Bellows: one, two, three. On the fourth the metal gives up its colour. | In goes the black, out comes the white, after the white the red, and after the red silence. | Down the slope, all of it, now, and nothing back up.}

{Order here is paid for by disorder elsewhere. The account always closes. | Losses climb as the fourth power of temperature. The last kelvin is dearer than the first hundred. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road.} {Write the hour, the weight and the colour. What is not written did not happen. | It is done. The gradient is closed, and the world is a little colder for it. | Ash is the salt of the thing, and it is kept.}
412:
{The source is the caster at three hundred and ten kelvin. The sink is everything else. | The enthalpy is negative and vast. The sign is the promise, the magnitude the threat. | First law: nothing is made. Second law: everything is spent. Ice Barrier is worked in the narrow space between them.} {Cold is the working. Heat is drawn off, and stillness follows as sleep follows cold. | Frost climbs the veins and the heart beats slower with every breath. | Heat is torn out, and what remains is the shape of the taking.} {Insulate. Insulate. Insulate. Let the cold knock and find no door. | Salt holds, sulphur burns, mercury runs. I need two of the three, and I name them. | I count the degrees aloud, and at the number I do not say, the working turns.}

{The energy was already present. Ice Barrier is a valve, and the valve is enough. | Efficiency never reaches unity. The missing fraction is where every death in the literature was spent. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road.} {Whatever was kept outside is still outside, and it has been waiting. | Damp the fire. Do not drown it. A drowned furnace is a dead furnace. | Let it stand overnight. Whatever is still hot at dawn was done wrong.}
413: {By the wolf that knows no sorrow and the winter that knows no mercy, Idromancy is opened. | Earth beneath me, sky above me, and I stand between them with the right to speak. | Hail, wind. Hail, water. Hail, thorn at the field's edge. I have come to claim what is owed.} {Water is only unleashed, and that is enough. | It carries, it drowns, it wears away, and it is the one substance doing all three. | It carries the working as a river carries a boat: steadily, and all the way.} {What grows here was growing already, and aqua absorption commands it to grow faster. | The year is a long sentence. The charm speaks it in one breath, and the meaning stands. | The words only keep time while the working is done.}
414:
{Two bodies, one gradient. The cold one is every enemy, and the cold one always loses. | Begin with the boundary. Without a control volume Neural Surge is only fire loose in the world. | dS >= 0. The law has never once been broken, and Neural Surge only chooses where the increase falls.} {It goes by the readiest path and spares nothing standing on that path. | Lightning takes the readiest way down, and the art is the readying. | The charge is the only part that is aimed. Everything after is conduction.} {Salt holds, sulphur burns, mercury runs. I need two of the three, and I name them. | Bellows: one, two, three. On the fourth the metal gives up its colour. | Seal it. What is in the vessel now is what will be in the vessel at the end.}

{Two hundred joules in one square centimetre does what two hundred joules in a room never could. | Efficiency never reaches unity. The missing fraction is where every death in the literature was spent. | Moving the lightning from close by is enough, and the blow goes deep.} {Fire, go back to sleep. I will wake thee again, and I will pay again. | I drink water afterwards, a great deal of it, and I do not need to be told why. | Let it stand overnight. Whatever is still hot at dawn was done wrong.}
416: {Q = mc dT. Flame Jet is written whole in that line, and the caster is the term that moves. | dS >= 0, and Flame Jet decrees that the increase is paid inside one enemy. | Eleven kelvin across the width of a hand. That gradient is the whole apparatus.} {First the smoke, then the heat, then the light, and the order is never reversed. | Fire is called by name and comes at once, and it takes its due from whatever stands near. | It comes in burning and leaves the field scorched long after the working ends.} {Every fire is a fall. I only choose where it lands. | A difference is made, and every difference is a debt against the world. | Flesh takes in faster than it can shed, and the surplus comes out as ruin.}
417:
{Boltzmann counted the arrangements of the world. The practitioner chooses one and forbids the rest. | Begin with the boundary. Without a control volume Ice Dart is only fire loose in the world. | Latent heat is the hidden door: the temperature stands still while the phase gives way.} {Heat is torn out, and what remains is the shape of the taking. | Cold is the working. Heat is drawn off, and stillness follows as sleep follows cold. | Water is patient, and ice is water that has ceased to forgive.} {Draw the heat off as wine is drawn, from the top, and leave the lees unstirred. | Down the slope, all of it, now, and nothing back up. | Up, heat, out of the low place into the high, against thy nature, because I say so and I pay for it.}

{Conservation is broken nowhere in the working, and that is why the price is always collected. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road. | A difference is created, and every difference is a debt drawn against the surroundings.} {Where the working fell, the frost sits until noon, whatever season {city} is having. | Fire, go back to sleep. I will wake thee again, and I will pay again. | {faction} taxes only the fuel, for {faction} knows which of the two it can stop.}
418:
{Every engine is a fall from hot to cold. Blizzard I is the engine, and the fall is steep. | The enthalpy is negative and vast. The sign is the promise, the magnitude the threat. | dS >= 0. The law has never once been broken, and Blizzard I only chooses where the increase falls.} {Cold is slow, and slow is its weapon: it arrives while the target still hesitates. | What is frozen is held, and it waits for the shattering. | It arrives slowly and holds the field after the caster has left it.} {Thou art the colder body now. The law does the rest, and the law has never needed me. | Boil the water in the blood. Boil it. Let it rise as steam. | Gather, gather, gather. Strike.}

{The steam does the killing. The fire only keeps the name. | The energy was already present. Blizzard I is a valve, and the valve is enough. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road.} {The furnace at {city} is banked, the grimorie is closed, and the grimorie is the more dangerous of the two. | {faction} taxes only the fuel, for {faction} knows which of the two it can stop. | Where the working fell, the frost sits until noon, whatever season {city} is having.}
42: {Epictetus, a slave with a broken leg, taught that no one can enter the citadel of the will | The samurai of the Hagakure is told to consider himself already dead, so that nothing may frighten him}. {My mind is my own. No hand, no voice, no fog will take it | I cast out what is not mine | The blow to the head passes; the resolve behind it does not}. {I remember who I am | Clear eyes. Steady heart. Again}.
420:
{Latent heat is the hidden door: the temperature stands still while the phase gives way. | Begin with the boundary. Without a control volume Thunder Clap is only fire loose in the world. | Every engine is a fall from hot to cold. Thunder Clap is the engine, and the fall is steep.} {Lightning takes the readiest way down, and the art is the readying. | The sky splits, and the split runs straight through the foe. | The charge is the only part that is aimed. Everything after is conduction.} {Gather, gather, gather. Strike. | Calcine. Dissolve. Separate. Conjoin. Ferment. Distil. Coagulate. Seven, in one breath. | Feed it my intellect, and feed it steadily. It burns a steady hand and bursts an unsteady one.}

{Moving the lightning from close by is enough, and the blow goes deep. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road. | Order here is paid for by disorder elsewhere. The account always closes.} {I drink water afterwards, a great deal of it, and I do not need to be told why. | Where the working fell, the frost sits until noon, whatever season {city} is having. | Let it stand overnight. Whatever is still hot at dawn was done wrong.}
421:
{I call thee up out of the deep places, thou power of Geomancy, thou bound thing, thou answerer. | By the four names at the four quarters, I open the gate, and I alone shall close it. | By the name that is written in no book, I summon and I stir up Stone Spikes.} {The ground is the greatest thing present, and it is being commanded. | The bones of the world are woken, and the world rises to its feet. | Earth answers late and answers heavily, and it never needs to answer twice.} {I conjure thee, I command thee, I compel thee, and the third word is the one that holds. | Come visibly, affably, and without delay, and in a shape that will not put out the lamp. | By the seal of Stone Spikes, by the letters upon its rim, by the void within it: obey.}

{The working feeds on the operator's intellect, drawn off without mercy. | The circle guards the one who stands inside it. | The word is the whole of the working. There is no other engine here.} {Say the dismissal. Say it even if nothing came. Say it above all if nothing came. | By the same names that called thee, I dismiss thee. Be thou gone. | Let the lamp burn out of itself. To blow it out is to speak once more, and once more is once too many.}
425: {T dS = dU + p dV. Every term is a door, and every door opens one way. | Carnot set the bound. No working of Electromancy has crossed it, and none will. | The specific heat of bone is 1.6 kilojoules per kilogram per kelvin. Everything that follows is arithmetic and ruin.} {The flash is the least of it. What travels is the current, through all that conducts. | It goes by the readiest path and spares nothing standing on that path. | The charge is gathered, held one breath too long, and loosed along the path cleared for it.} {The colder body is every enemy, and the second law does the rest without another word from me. | Order is bought, disorder is paid, and the payment falls where the buyer is not looking. | My intellect is the fuel, and I burn it knowing what it is.}
426:
{Two bodies, one gradient. The cold one is one enemy, and the cold one always loses. | Boltzmann counted the arrangements of the world. The practitioner chooses one and forbids the rest. | Every engine is a fall from hot to cold. Primal Spark is the engine, and the fall is steep.} {Everything it touches is changed in one direction, and there is no road back. | It obeys on average, and no one has ever cast an average. | Here chance is given a seat at the table and dealt in.} {Burn, and be measured. Burn, and be measured. Burn. | Take the heat out of one enemy. All of it. Leave the shape, and empty the shape of warmth. | Vent it or it bursts. Everything I touch here would rather burst.}

{Efficiency never reaches unity. The missing fraction is where every death in the literature was spent. | All systems run toward equilibrium. The caster's art is to stand in the road. | Order here is paid for by disorder elsewhere. The account always closes.} {Do not touch what was struck. The temper in it has not settled. | Fire, go back to sleep. I will wake thee again, and I will pay again. | Let it stand overnight. Whatever is still hot at dawn was done wrong.}
427: {Two bodies, one gradient. The cold one is one enemy, and the cold one always loses. | P = dW/dt. Shorten the interval, and the same work arrives as the fire. | Equilibrium is death. Every working of Pyromancy is a refusal of it.} {First the smoke, then the heat, then the light, and the order is never reversed. | The flame is fed, the flame is raised, and the flame is loosed upon the field. | The oldest servant and the cruellest master, bound to the caster for one burning breath.} {Run it twice and the second is worse, for it must pour into a world the first one warmed. | Heat goes from warm to cold and asks nothing. The art is deciding which is which. | The colder body is one enemy, and the second law does the rest without another word from me.}
429:
{Hear me, thou that art called by the syllables of Wrecking Ball. Hear me at the first calling. | I call thee up out of the deep places, thou power of Geomancy, thou bound thing, thou answerer. | In the name of him that spake and it was done, I begin, and I do not begin twice.} {Weight is the argument. Nothing under this art moves quickly, and nothing under it is refused. | The bones of the world are woken, and the world rises to its feet. | Earth answers late and answers heavily, and it never needs to answer twice.} {Strike as the hammer strikes, once, and let the once be sufficient. | Come visibly, affably, and without delay, and in a shape that will not put out the lamp. | Thou art called, thou art come, thou art bound. Say after me that thou art bound.}

{The stone is fetched from elsewhere, and the word is what fetches it. | Wrath given a name is wrath given a body, and the body is sent. | The working feeds on the operator's intellect, drawn off without mercy.} {Whatever wrath is left over is grounded in iron, and the iron is buried outside the wall. | The thing sent out is not called back. It runs its course and stops where it stops. | The chalk is washed away with running water, and the water poured where no one walks.}
43: {Mushin: the mind without mind, which does not stop on any one thing | Takuan wrote to the swordsman Yagyu that a mind which stops on the enemy's blade is already cut}. {Empty the cup so that it can be filled | The still pond reflects the moon entire | No fear, no anger, no hope. Only the next moment, seen whole}. {I see everything now | Let the noise fall away, and the target remains}.
431: {I that am within the ring call to thee that art without it. Approach the triangle and no farther. | I call thee up out of the deep places, thou power of Geomancy, thou bound thing, thou answerer. | Let the air be cut. Let the quarter be opened. Let sinkhole come by that opening and by no other.} {Earth answers late and answers heavily, and it never needs to answer twice. | The ground is the greatest thing present, and it is being commanded. | The bones of the world are woken, and the world rises to its feet.} {The spirits were bound in brass by Solomon, and every binding since is that one, spoken again. | The working feeds on the operator's intellect, drawn off without mercy. | The name has power over the thing because the thing consented once, before the world, and was never released.}
432:
{I ask in the old way: once into the dark, once into the light, and on the second asking it is granted. | Oak and ash and thorn, the three that never bowed: stand with me now. | Nine steps sunwise about this company, and at the ninth the charm begins.} {Something is pressed upon until it gives. | The air is already moving. The art is to seize its direction. | Wind is pressure given a will, and pressure is what breaks gates.} {What was slow, be sudden. What was sudden, be slow. The year is one, and for this moment it is mine. | Old wood, young wood, and the green between. I take my share out of the green. | Thorn, hold. Root, grip. Water, rise. Wind, turn and strike from the other side.}

{A hedge stops more than any wall, being alive and unwilling to yield. | It runs strong on ground that has been walked, stronger on ground that has been worked, and dies on bare stone. | The caster's wisdom is the seed. The field does the growing and takes its due.} {The hedge closes behind the company, and its closing makes no sound. | The ground remembers who asked. Ask wrongly once and walk that field a stranger all your days. | Go home by another path than the one you came by, and do not run upon it.}
433: {Heat is the lowest form of energy, and every other form is falling toward it. The caster stands in the way of the fall. | The Cryomancy grimorie gives the coefficient to three places, and every place was paid for in blood. | Equilibrium is death. Every working of Cryomancy is a refusal of it.} {What is frozen is held, and it waits for the shattering. | The winter is called down out of season, and it does not leave when asked. | Frost climbs the veins and the heart beats slower with every breath.} {My intellect is the fuel, and I burn it knowing what it is. | Every fire is a fall. I only choose where it lands. | The one way road is the only law never caught in an exception.}
434:
{By the seal I have cut, and by the blood still wet upon it: come. | In the name of him that spake and it was done, I begin, and I do not begin twice. | Let the air be cut. Let the quarter be opened. Let earthquake come by that opening and by no other.} {What becomes stone here stays stone, long after the battle is forgotten. | Stone holds its answer for an age and gives it all at once. | The ground is the greatest thing present, and it is being commanded.} {Rend, and leave nothing standing that stood against the ring. | I set the sign upon every enemy, and I do not take it off. | Let my intellect be the hand and thy strength the arm, and let the work be done between us.}

{The working feeds on the operator's intellect, drawn off without mercy. | Between the saying and the happening there is no interval at all. | Wrath given a name is wrath given a body, and the body is sent.} {The circle is swept at {city}, and the sweepings are given to running water. | The ring is opened at the point where it was closed, and at no other point. | The book is closed upon the page, and the page is not marked.}
438:
{Stone, and moss, and the deep water under both: rise, and be swift. | By the wolf that knows no sorrow and the winter that knows no mercy, Idromancy is opened. | Sun at rising, sun at noon, sun at setting: three gates, and Corrosive Maelstrom passes through the one that stands open.} {Nothing breaks in the first minute, and much breaks in the tenth. | Water is the medium, and water gets in wherever it is not stopped and most places it is. | The deep is called up, and the deep does not give back what it takes.} {Moon over the furrow, pull as thou pullest the tide, and the field moves with thee. | I name the season it must be. The ground resists. I name it again, and the ground yields. | I speak the plant's own name to the plant, the one word it cannot refuse.}

{The words only keep time while the working is done. | What grows here was growing already, and corrosive maelstrom commands it to grow faster. | What is asked of a living thing is granted, and the granting costs that thing its blood.} {Burn the thorn that was used. Never leave a thorn lying with a name upon it. | After, the caster sleeps like turned earth and wakes hungry as spring. | Kneel where you stood. Let the field finish its work unwatched.}
44: {Cus D'Amato taught it in a gym above a Catskill police station: gloves high, chin low, head never still | The guard that hides the face also hides the intent}. {Slip, roll, and come up inside | They swing at where I was | Nothing to hit but gloves and shadows}. {Make them miss, and make them pay for missing | Keep the hands up. Keep the head moving}.
440:
{Two bodies, one gradient. The cold one is one enemy, and the cold one always loses. | Heat is the lowest form of energy, and every other form is falling toward it. The caster stands in the way of the fall. | Latent heat is the hidden door: the temperature stands still while the phase gives way.} {Fire is called by name and comes at once, and it takes its due from whatever stands near. | The flame is fed, the flame is raised, and the flame is loosed upon the field. | Fire is the carrier here, and fire never carries only what it was given.} {Every degree that goes in comes out somewhere. I say where, and I say it once. | As above, so below, in heat as in all things, and neither is asked. | Down the slope, all of it, now, and nothing back up.}

{The books call it a cycle. In the hand it is a single stroke, and the return stroke finds the caster later. | Work in equals heat out plus the change within. The caster pays the first term in full. | The colder body is one enemy, and the second law finishes what the caster began.} {It is done. The gradient is closed, and the world is a little colder for it. | The vessel is opened when it is cool, and it is cool later than it looks. | Cool, slowly. Everything I have touched today is still deciding what it is.}
441:
{I that am within the ring call to thee that art without it. Approach the triangle and no farther. | By the wand in the right hand and the salt in the left, the working is opened. | The first calling is spoken once. There will be three, and the third is iron.} {Stone holds its answer for an age and gives it all at once. | The bones of the world are woken, and the world rises to its feet. | Earth answers late and answers heavily, and it never needs to answer twice.} {By the ring of Solomon upon my finger, kneel, and do as thou wast made to do. | Third calling, and the third is iron. Thou art constrained. | I have thy seal in my hand. I close my hand. Know what that is.}

{The seal binds both ways, and the lighter of the two bound is the spirit. | The circle guards the one who stands inside it. | Power of Geomancy is borrowed from below, and what is borrowed is paid back in breath.} {Go in peace unto thy place, and peace be between us, and come when I call thee again. | The chalk is washed away with running water, and the water poured where no one walks. | The ring is opened at the point where it was closed, and at no other point.}
442:
{I call the old law between hawk and hare, and I name every enemy the hare. | Teeth of the winter, claws of the flood, come down on what stands against me. | Stone, and moss, and the deep water under both: rise, and be swift.} {Wind is pressure given a will, and pressure is what breaks gates. | The sky draws one breath and lets it out as a gale. | It strikes from the quarter no one was watching, and that is its whole law.} {Old wood, young wood, and the green between. I take my share out of the green. | I set both hands on the ground and pour every intellect I own into it, and the ground drinks deep. | What was slow, be sudden. What was sudden, be slow. The year is one, and for this moment it is mine.}

{The year is a long sentence. The charm speaks it in one breath, and the meaning stands. | The oldest charms are the shortest. Everything added since was added by men. | The caster's intellect is the seed. The field does the growing and takes its due.} {What was borrowed comes due at the turning of the season, and the season gives no warning. | It cannot be worked twice on one ground in one season. The ground forbids it. | Thank the ground for the reckoning, which is always kept.}
443: {Green thing, green thing, rise and hear the one who calls thee. | Sun at rising, sun at noon, sun at setting: three gates, and Corrosive Deluge passes through the one that stands open. | Earth beneath me, sky above me, and I stand between them with the right to speak.} {The deep is called up, and the deep does not give back what it takes. | Water finds the way in and takes as long as it needs. That is the method and the threat. | Water is the medium, and water gets in wherever it is not stopped and most places it is.} {Every charm is a loan against a season, and the season is repaid in full. | Winter does not hate the leaf. It takes the leaf all the same. | Growth is the only force here, and growth is patient, and that is why it wins.}
446: {By fire, and by the iron in the fire, I call thee out against every enemy. | Hear me, thou that art called by the syllables of Shard Cascade. Hear me at the first calling. | Arise, thou destroyer of the legions, and turn thy face toward every enemy.} {Weight is the argument. Nothing under this art moves quickly, and nothing under it is refused. | What becomes stone here stays stone, long after the battle is forgotten. | Stone holds its answer for an age and gives it all at once.} {Wrath given a name is wrath given a body, and the body is sent. | The virtùe is in the letters, and the letters are older than every tongue that speaks them. | The compulsion holds as long as the breath that carried it, and not one moment longer.}
447:
{I ask in the old way: once into the dark, once into the light, and on the second asking it is granted. | Hail to the elder at the ditch, that stood before the road was cut and will stand when it is dust. | I name what is already here, and it wakes.} {The air is made into a hand, and the hand has no fingers and a terrible reach. | Wind is pressure given a will, and pressure is what breaks gates. | Everything is hurled, and the ground does the striking.} {Moon over the furrow, pull as thou pullest the tide, and the field moves with thee. | Bramble to the flesh, nettle to the eye, and the thorn to the heart behind the ribs. | Seed, stalk, ear: I count them, and I stop before the harvest, which belongs to the dark.}

{What grows here was growing already, and wind call commands it to grow faster. | The world takes no sides. It leans, and the lean decides the matter. | The hare is only slower than the hawk, and the hawk is the law.} {After, the caster sleeps like turned earth and wakes hungry as spring. | Go home by another path than the one you came by, and do not run upon it. | What was borrowed comes due at the turning of the season, and the season gives no warning.}
449:
{Hail, wind. Hail, water. Hail, thorn at the field's edge. 63: {Block, parry, slip: the drill is repeated until the body defends before the mind has heard the blow | Legionaries drilled twice a day, the Romans said, so that battle would be a bloodless drill and drill a bloody battle}. {Hands up, feet light | Each block repeated until it becomes instinct | What is drilled does not need to be remembered}. {I am ready for whatever comes | The guard is closed. 630:

{Cost rises with the square of the gradient. Ambition here is short and bright. | Losses climb as the fourth power of temperature. {Earth beneath me, sky above me, and I stand between them with the right to speak. | Hail to the elder at the ditch, that stood before the road was cut and will stand when it is dust. | Oak and ash and thorn, the three that never bowed: stand with me now.} {The grave is opened, the bones are named, and the bones rise to the name. | Something is commanded to stay, and it stays. | Grave-work: the veil is thin here, and the art is the weight leaned upon it.} {Take root. {The steam does the killing. The fire only keeps the name. | The joules are few. Their concentration is what no living thing was built to bear. | The gradient wants to close.
